bio_md:
# 天祚帝耶律延禧 · 主要事迹

耶律延禧（1075—1128），[[liao-dao-zong|道宗]]之孙，太子浚之子。寿昌七年（1101）即位，改元乾统。

天祚帝纵情畋猎、拒听谏言，朝政日坏；恰逢女真完颜部崛起，天庆四年（1114）[[jin-tai-zu|完颜阿骨打]]起兵反辽，宁江州、出河店诸役辽军连败，一蹶不振。此后中京、南京相继陷落，天祚西奔夹山，保大五年（1125）于应州为金将完颜娄室所俘，辽亡。

天祚帝被俘后降封海滨王，天会六年（1128）卒于金地。女真之兴虽在阿骨打之强，实亦辽政之朽——一个政权的崩塌，往往先自内部开始。

bio_parts_en.value:
and son of Crown Prince Jun, ascended in 1101, era Qiantong.

Tianzuo hunted, ignored counsel, and let government rot - precisely when the Jurchen Wanyan clan was rising. In 1114

revolted against Liao; at Ningjiangzhou, Chuhedian, and beyond, the Liao armies were smashed one after another. The Central and Southern Capitals fell; Tianzuo fled west into the mountains and was captured at Yingzhou in 1125. Liao fell.

Reduced to a marquis by the Jin, he died in 1128. The Jurchen rise owed much to Aguda's strength, but more to Liao's decay - a state's collapse begins within.
